senses.gloss: Rādhagupta, n. of a son of Bindusāraʼs minister, who became Aśokaʼs minister: Divy 〔370.24〕; 〔373.9 ff., 403.12 ff.〕; 〔425.11〕; it is clearly implied that he was a reincarnation of Vijaya (2), 〔402.15〕; 〔429.22 ff.〕
[rādhyate, wrong reading in LV 〔342.16〕 (vs), where for Lefm. nirāparādhyeṣv api rādhyate yaḥ, read with v.l. ˚yeṣv aparādh˚; so Tib., ñes byed pa.]
